home.title: Your engagements
home.adminNote: Platform administrator — you can see every project.
home.emptyAdmin: No projects yet. Create a client and a project under Administration.
home.emptyUser: You have not been given access to a project yet. Ask a project owner or a platform administrator.
project.dashboardBody: Plan vs actual and BR/FR status per workstream arrive with the build slices. The business function chart and requirements come first (slice 1).
program.subtitle: Program view — each project keeps its own data.

admin.title: Administration
admin.subtitle: Platform administrators only. Creating a project grants nobody access — give access from the project's Access screen.
admin.name: Name
admin.deactivateBody: {name} will be signed out on their next click and cannot sign in again. Their history stays.
admin.adminBodyGrant: {name} will see every client's projects. Give the reason — it is kept in the audit log.
admin.adminBodyRemove: {name} will no longer see restricted projects they are not a member of, or the administration screens. Choose what they become and give the reason — it is kept in the audit log.
home.kindNote.USER: You can open and edit every project except restricted ones you are not a member of.
home.kindNote.VIEWER: You can open and read every project except restricted ones you are not a member of.
access.title: Who can open this project
access.subtitle: Platform administrators see every project. Other staff see every project that is not restricted; a restricted project is open only to its members.
access.adminOnly: Only a platform administrator can see and change who has access.
access.unrestricted: Not restricted — every staff member can open it: {users} users (can edit) and {viewers} viewers (read only).
access.restricted: Restricted — only the members below and platform administrators can open it.
access.unrestrictTitle: Open this project to all staff?
access.loses: Lose access on their next click: {list}
access.membersNote: Members apply while the project is restricted. You can prepare the list before restricting it.
access.viewerCapped: This person is a viewer, so they can only read, whatever their membership says.
access.removeBody: {name} loses access to this restricted project on their next click. To give it back, add them again.
admin.restricted.no: No — every staff member can open it
access.removeBodyOpen: {name} is removed from the member list. While the project is not restricted they can still open it, as every staff member can.
admin.makeUserBody: {name} will be able to edit every project that is not restricted, from their next click.
